title: AI Promo Video Maker for New Products | AIVideosUGC
description: Use this AI promo video maker to announce a new product with a warm, polished clip. Upload one photo, choose 9:16 or 1:1, and make your launch video today.
h1: AI Promo Video Maker for Your Next Product Launch
lead: This AI promo video maker announces something new with a warm, styled clip. Start from a shot of the product, describe the room it belongs in, and get a short video for Facebook and Instagram. Clips run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
intro: Your new product appears in the room where it belongs, styled like an ad on launch day. The sample clip features a slim white cordless lamp glowing on a wooden side table beside a stack of books, a mug, and a potted plant in a cozy, dim room.

Seeing the product in a real space helps people picture it at home before they read a word. It works for decor, small appliances, gadgets, and gift items. Use 9:16 for Stories and Reels, or 1:1 for the Facebook and Instagram feed.
tip: Describe the time of day and the room, like "evening living room, warm light, lamp on a side table," so the product looks lived with rather than staged.

steps.d: A clean shot from your launch photos is enough, and the video builds the room around it.
Describe the space and mood, then pick 9:16 or 1:1. Six seconds suits a teaser; 10 or 15 gives a fuller scene, while 30 seconds gives room for a sequence.
Type "New," your release date, and any offer in Canva or Ads Manager so every word is exactly right.

ideas.d: Make a 6-second version with darker light and post it before release day.
Generate a second version in the same kind of room and add your intro discount in your editor.
Place the product on a table set for a birthday or the holidays to pitch it as a present.

faq.q: Can the video show my launch date and price?
faq.a: Add those yourself after downloading. AI can misspell words or scramble numbers, so dates, prices, and "New" badges are safer typed in Canva, CapCut, or Ads Manager.

faq.q: Should I make a square or a vertical version?
faq.a: Vertical 9:16 fills the screen in Stories and Reels, and square 1:1 sits neatly in the feed. You can make one of each. Every version is its own run, with the cost shown before it starts.

faq.q: Can I make a promo before my product photos are ready?
faq.a: You can start from a text description alone, but the product won't match your real one. For an ad, wait until you have a clear photo of the final item so shoppers see what they'll actually get.

faq.q: What length should a launch promo use?
faq.a: Use 6 seconds for a quick reveal, 10 or 15 seconds for a product action, and 30 seconds only where the public option is available. Choose 9:16 for vertical placements.

overview.h2: Build anticipation with a place for the product
overview.d: A launch promo should establish what is new, where it belongs, and which visual detail deserves the first look. Describe the room, the light, and a small reveal or glow so the product feels introduced rather than merely displayed.
Use the generated scene for the visual announcement, then add the exact date, offer, URL, and availability yourself. This lets you reuse the same scene when a release detail changes.

input_guide.h2: Prepare a new product for its first scene

items.d: Choose the view that makes the product recognizable before the room and props are added.
For a lamp, speaker, or appliance, keep the button, shade, grille, or other launch-worthy detail visible.
Say bedside table, kitchen counter, desk, entryway, or gift table so the scene explains where the item belongs.
Ask for open wall, tabletop, or sky beside the product when a date or URL will sit over the finished clip.

results.h2: What the launch asset gives you

items.d: The product appears in a room that matches its use, with a reveal, glow, or camera move to mark the introduction.
Pick 9:16 for Stories and Reels, 1:1 for a feed, 16:9 for a wide launch placement, or 4:3 and 3:4 when needed.
Six, ten, fifteen, and thirty seconds cost 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits; the exact charge appears before generation.
A slim lamp turns on beside books and a plant as evening light falls across the side table.
A new espresso machine sits on a clean counter while a cup enters the frame and the camera moves to its control panel.
A compact speaker or monitor is unboxed onto a calm work desk, ending with a clear front view.
A small device rests on a wrapped gift table with one slow pass across the package and product.

after_download.h2: Put the launch facts on top

items.d: Type the confirmed day, time, and timezone in a layer you can edit when plans change.
Use the current price, introductory offer, or product link from your launch plan.
Add your licensed track or announcement voice once the reveal timing feels right.

fit.h2: A strong fit for launch promos
good: Decor, appliances, gadgets, and gift items
Products with a clear room or use context
Scenes that need editable copy space
not_ideal: Live inventory or countdown information that must update automatically
Products whose launch story needs several unrelated demonstrations
